parameters.help_en: The sound code parsing content for the period. The value must be 1 to 512 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en: The description of the period. The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters
parameters.help_zh: 时间段描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The start time of the period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59
parameters.help_zh: 时间段开始时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 时间段结束时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59，不能早于StartTime
